title: Validity is preserved by a tape move
statement: Let a finite sequence of segments be given, each consisting of a Boolean word and a Boolean flag. For a segment index $s$ within this sequence, suppose a tape position is valid: positions at the left or right boundary are always valid, and a position at a cell is valid when its cell index is less than that segment's word length. For any move direction, the resulting segment index remains within the sequence, and the resulting position is valid for that segment.

The starting position is valid for segment $s$
